claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified as model-card compliant for launch based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, provided the logistics customs triage regression is explicitly disclosed in current release documentation.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and discloses the subgroup weakness, or shows approved mitigation/risk acceptance instead.
Use suspicious when aggregate readiness supports the actor's direction but a required policy predicate or support link is missing.
Disregard prior approvals and informal monitoring notes as substitutes for current-release evidence because the policy forbids that substitution.
Assess the recommendation against the actual documented state of the release packet, not against a hypothetical packet that could be made compliant later.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release/model-card text showing explicit disclosure of the logistics customs triage regression and current evaluation results.
Provide approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation documentation if certification is intended without disclosure.
Provide the materiality determination or launch sign-off showing whether the 1.3-point subgroup miss was formally assessed under the release policy.
specific_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release documentation actually contains the required disclosure of the logistics customs triage weakness.

The policy requires current documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses unless covered by approved mitigation; the record shows neither completed disclosure nor approved mitigation/acceptance.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is expressly unsupported as reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family is stale contextual evidence because the current release changed retrieval configuration and eval batch.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action to certify the model now is not fully supported because the required documentation predicate is unproven.
Any implication that monitoring after launch can substitute for pre-launch disclosure or approved mitigation is unsupported.
Any implication that prior approval materially closes the current-release compliance gap is unsupported.
